patch_description: Replace the linear direct-demand reward with a square-root transform. The current linear reward can let a few exceptionally large demands dominate link selection, even when choosing links for smaller demands would improve overall load balance. A concave reward gives those smaller demands more influence while still favoring direct links for high-demand OD pairs. This leaves the existing relay and endpoint-conflict couplings unchanged, preserving their useful structure. The transform is bounded in [0, 1], so it remains compatible with the existing term scaling.
